description: Editable routing rules for the AI Inbox Triage Starter. The AI uses the labels and signals below to classify each email. Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first strong match wins. Edit the keywords, senders, and draft settings to fit your business. Nothing here sends email - drafts only.

rules.label: urgent
rules.when: The sender explicitly asks for a reply today, uses words like urgent, ASAP, emergency, deadline, or the message is a same-day cancellation or complaint.

rules.label: urgent
rules.when: An existing customer reports something broken, a failed payment, or a service outage.

rules.label: lead
rules.when: A new person asks about your services, pricing, availability, or wants to book or get a quote.

rules.label: lead
rules.when: Someone requests a meeting, demo, call, or consultation.

rules.label: lead
rules.when: A referral or warm introduction from an existing contact.

rules.label: invoice
rules.when: The email is an invoice, bill, receipt, payment request, or a supplier chasing payment.

rules.label: invoice
rules.when: A customer asks about their own invoice, a refund, or a billing discrepancy.

rules.label: newsletter
rules.when: Bulk marketing, product updates, or content digests from companies and tools.

rules.label: newsletter
rules.when: Automated no-reply notifications from platforms (social, SaaS, receipts you do not act on).

rules.label: other
rules.when: Internal team chatter, personal mail, or anything that does not fit the buckets above.

rules.label: urgent
rules.when: Anything mentioning legal action, a lawyer, a chargeback, or a public review threat - always route to a human.

rules.label: other
rules.when: When the AI confidence is below 0.5, default to 'other' and flag needs_human so nothing important is silently dropped.

never_promise: prices not confirmed by the owner
always: ask one clarifying question when info is missing
sign off with the owner first name only
draft_guardrails.hard_rule: Every output is a DRAFT. A human reviews and sends. The workflow contains no send action.
